question: In the experimental setup used to study the photoelectric effect, the evacuated glass/quartz tube is fitted with a photosensitive plate and a collector plate. What is the specific function of the quartz window provided in this setup?

options.A: To filter out visible light and allow only infrared radiation to pass
options.B: To allow ultraviolet radiation to pass through and irradiate the photosensitive plate
options.C: To maintain the vacuum inside the tube by preventing air leakage
options.D: To focus the incident light into a coherent beam
